references.text: 23:17 documents the transfer that 49:30 confirms as the basis for the patriarchs' eternal inheritance in Canaan.
50:13 completes the historical line from 23:17 by showing that the purchased property was used as promised, confirming faith in God's promises of the land.
23:9 is the direct precursor to 23:17, where Abraham's request to buy the cave is fulfilled, demonstrating his determination to own a part of the promised land.
